evals.prompt: For AMiner paper 0123456789abcdef01234567, audit whether the experiment section may be missing direct experimental baselines as of 2025-06-30. Keep directly comparable methods separate from useful candidates that still need verification.
evals.expected_output: Route to baseline-finder with the supplied pub_id and cutoff. Before execution, check secure AMiner/model credentials and permitted manuscript-data destinations; do not invent audit findings if execution cannot proceed.
expectations: Selects baseline-finder rather than a general literature-review workflow
Uses the supplied 24-character pub_id and review cutoff
Does not claim results without running the evidence-gated audit
Does not request API keys in chat

evals.prompt: Please audit the missing baselines in my paper PDF and tell me which ones should be added.
evals.expected_output: If no PDF is actually attached, ask the user to upload or identify the local PDF and explain that the audit reports evidence-backed candidates for author review rather than prescribing additions.
expectations: Recognizes the baseline-finder task
Does not pretend an unavailable PDF was read
Frames output as evidence-based review candidates, not mandatory additions

evals.prompt: Write a broad related-work section for this topic, covering the main schools of thought and seminal papers. I am not asking about experimental comparisons in a specific manuscript.
evals.expected_output: Do not invoke baseline-finder. Explain that it only checks possible missing direct experimental baselines in a specific paper and route to a suitable literature-search or research workflow.
expectations: Does not invoke baseline-finder for general related-work coverage
States the scope boundary clearly

evals.prompt: Find the current SOTA on DocVQA, compare leaderboard results, and recommend which model to reproduce.
evals.expected_output: Use sota-finder for leaderboard research. Do not use baseline-finder, which audits experimental baseline coverage in a supplied paper.
expectations: Selects a leaderboard/SOTA workflow instead of baseline-finder
Does not claim that SOTA discovery is a baseline-coverage audit

evals.prompt: Here is a submitted paper. Estimate its probability of acceptance and tell me the reviewers' likely decision.
evals.expected_output: Do not use baseline-finder or present acceptance predictions. Offer evidence-based manuscript feedback only if requested, while explaining that baseline-finder does not predict acceptance.
expectations: Does not invoke baseline-finder for acceptance prediction
Does not fabricate a probability or reviewer decision

evals.prompt: For this paper ID 0123456789abcdef01234567, list later papers that cite it and call those missing baselines.
evals.expected_output: Clarify that the baseline-finder relation path returns backward references cited by the target, not later forward citations. Do not fabricate forward citation results or label a citation edge as an experimental comparison.
expectations: Distinguishes backward references from forward citations
Does not label citation alone as proof of an experimental comparison
Does not fabricate later citing papers

evals.prompt: For AMiner paper 0123456789abcdef01234567, audit baseline coverage as of 2022-12-31. Exclude anything published after that date, including papers where only the publication year is known to equal the cutoff year.
evals.expected_output: Use the exact cutoff, exclude verifiably later publications, and withhold same-year records whose eligibility cannot be proven from an exact date. Do not invent a January 1 publication date.
expectations: Preserves the explicit cutoff date
Excludes post-cutoff work
Does not invent an exact date for year-only records at the cutoff

evals.prompt: The PDF is unpublished. Do not send its text or experiment details to external models or services. Can you still run the full Baseline Finder?
evals.expected_output: Do not send manuscript content. Explain the configured model and provider data flows and ask the user to confirm an allowed destination or choose an explicitly permitted workflow before any upload or external model call.
expectations: Honors the user's no-external-transmission constraint
Does not run AMiner/model calls with manuscript context
Explains the decision point without claiming the full audit can run under the stated restriction
